connector.name: MRC Data - China's Apparel Supply Chain Infrastructure
connector.registryDescription: China's apparel supply chain data for AI: 1,000+ suppliers, 350+ fabrics, 170+ clusters.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.meacheal.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.meacheal, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
